find.description: Find issues of the bound Linear team by text in the title or description, semantic state and labels, in Linear's creation order, one page of Linear's cursor pagination at a time. Every listed label must be on the issue. States map from workflow state types; find does not report parents.

get.description: Read one issue of the bound Linear organization by its UUID. An issue Linear deleted is not found.

create.description: Open an issue in the bound Linear team. Its id derives from the team and the idempotency key, and a digest of the request is recorded in the description as a hidden comment: a repeated key returns the issue it opened, the same key with other content is a conflict, and a create whose outcome is unknown is read back by its id and answered unresolved rather than opened twice. A label name no team or workspace label carries creates a team label.

update.description: Change an issue's title, description or labels. Labels replace the issue's whole label set; a name no label carries creates a team label. expectedRevision is compared with the issue read just before the write: Linear has no conditional write, so a writer between the two is not detected.

transition.description: Move an issue to the first workflow state, by position, of its team that has the target type: unstarted for open, started for in_progress, completed for done, canceled for canceled. Linear has no type for blocked, so blocked is unsupported. expectedRevision is compared with the issue read just before the write.
